name_vi: Túi mây đựng trang phục gập đôi
description_en: A folding garment carrier using two large flexible woven panels, textile hinge, internal hanger hook and leather handles. Canonical front: the woven upper panel with two carry-handle straps. Side view: the thick folded textile spine and zipper track. Rear view: the lower woven panel with a plain hanger-hook port. All panels, linings, hardware and inserts are completely unmarked; no text, logos, symbols or labels. Keep the identical structure, materials and attachments across all three views.
prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create ONE original photorealistic Vietnamese rattan/bamboo studio catalog product. Subject: A folding garment carrier using two large flexible woven panels, textile hinge, internal hanger hook and leather handles. Canonical front: the woven upper panel with two carry-handle straps. Side view: the thick folded textile spine and zipper track. Rear view: the lower woven panel with a plain hanger-hook port. All panels, linings, hardware and inserts are completely unmarked; no text, logos, symbols or labels. Keep the identical structure, materials and attachments across all three views.. Style Sang trọng: refined precise proportions and minimal plain hardware. Relative size compact within its class, no measurements. Main woven surfaces: open square lattice made from wider flat strips. Finish: natural matte honey-tan fibers. Believable smooth bindings, continuous strips, stable wood/bamboo frame and only specified plain secondary materials. All interiors empty. CAMERA: exact straight-on FRONT ELEVATION at azimuth zero, directly facing its described front feature, level with product center. No three-quarter or overhead angle. This is the canonical FRONT image for subsequent views of the same design. Whole object visible, centered with generous margins. Plain warm-white seamless studio backdrop, soft lighting and subtle shadow, sharp fiber texture. Square image. No props, room, people, animals, food, plants, detached extra products, collage, diagram or border. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT ANYWHERE: no letters, numbers, words, symbols, labels, logos, captions, watermarks, measurements or inscriptions.

visual_review.method: manual comparison of canonical front and three-view review sheet
